title: Urology and Continence Supply Program patient account schedule: payment plans and past-due holds
content:
The patient account terms of the Urology and Continence Supply Program set two things for each tier: when an interest-free payment plan is available, and when an unpaid balance holds further shipments. The figures differ by payer program.

## Terms

- **Smallest plan balance**: the smallest patient balance, in USD, for which an interest-free payment plan may be requested.
- **Longest plan term**: the longest interest-free payment plan, counted in monthly installments. A figure of 0 means payment plans are not offered on the tier.
- **Smallest monthly installment**: the smallest monthly installment, in USD, accepted on a payment plan.
- **Past-due age**: the age, in calendar days after its posting date, at which an unpaid patient-balance posting becomes past due for the shipment hold test. A figure of 0 means shipments are never held for a past-due balance on the tier.
- **Past-due hold amount**: the past-due amount, in USD, at or above which further shipments are held under the past-due rule.

## Schedule

| Basis | Continence Self-Pay Program | Continence Commercial HMO Program | Continence Commercial PPO Program | Continence Medicare Advantage Program | Continence Original Medicare Program | Continence Medicaid Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smallest plan balance | 150.00 USD | 150.00 USD | 150.00 USD | 100.00 USD | 100.00 USD | 100.00 USD |
| Longest plan term (monthly installments) | 0 | 6 | 6 | 10 | 10 | 0 |
| Smallest monthly installment | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 20.00 USD | 20.00 USD | 20.00 USD |
| Past-due age (days after posting) | 15 | 90 | 90 | 120 | 120 | 0 |
| Past-due hold amount | 50.00 USD | 75.00 USD | 75.00 USD | 75.00 USD | 75.00 USD | 75.00 USD |


## Points of reading

- On the Continence Self-Pay Program and the Continence Medicaid Program the longest plan term is 0. No payment plan is offered on either tier, whatever the balance.
- On the Continence Medicaid Program the past-due age is 0. Shipments on that tier are never held for a past-due balance.
- The hold amount is reached when the past-due amount is equal to it or above it. **Hypothetical boundary:** on a tier with a 75.00 USD hold amount, a past-due amount of exactly 75.00 USD reaches it, and 74.99 USD does not.
